apiKeys.title: API Management
apiKeys.needKyc: API keys need Verified Plus identity verification.
apiKeys.label: Label
apiKeys.labelHint: So you can tell your keys apart.
apiKeys.ipsHint: One address or range per line. Leave it empty to allow any address.
apiKeys.secretOnce: Copy the secret key now. It's shown only this once; if you lose it, create a new key.
apiKeys.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete this API key? Anything using it stops at once.
apiKeys.rule1: API keys are created here and nowhere else. The API itself cannot create or revoke one, so a stolen key can never mint another.
apiKeys.rule2: Creating a key needs identity verification at the Intermediate level and a code from your authenticator, even though you are already signed in.
apiKeys.rule3: The secret is shown once, at creation. It is encrypted and can never be shown again — if you lose it, create a new key and revoke the old one.
apiKeys.rule4: A key can read your account and it can trade. Withdrawals are not offered through the API at all.
apiKeys.rule5: Restrict a key to the IP addresses you call from. A correctly signed request from any other address is refused.
apiKeys.rule6: Give a key an expiry, and revoke it as soon as it is no longer used. Revoking takes effect within a minute, including on connections that are already open.
apiKeys.subRule1: A sub-account's keys are created and revoked here by its master. A sub never signs in, so it can neither mint a key nor revoke one — not even its own.
apiKeys.subRule2: Creating one needs your identity verification and a code from your authenticator, the same bar as a key on your own account.
apiKeys.subRule3: The secret is shown once, at creation. It is encrypted and can never be shown again — if you lose it, create a new key and revoke the old one.
apiKeys.subRule4: A key reads and trades that one sub-account, nothing else. It reaches neither its master nor any sibling, and withdrawals are not offered through the API at all.
apiKeys.subRule5: A sub-account's key cannot be edited. Revoke it and create another with the rights you need; revoking takes effect within a minute, including on connections already open.

copy.applyNote1: The amount moves from your main account into your lead account as soon as it is created, in {asset}.
copy.applyNote2: While you lead you can add funds at any time and take out {asset} above the {min} {asset} the account keeps. Only {asset} markets can be traded from it.
copy.applyNote3: To stop leading, sell what the account holds and cancel its orders first; each sale is copied to your followers. Afterwards everything in it can be taken out.

what.a: You fund a copy account tied to one leader. Each order the leader's lead account fills is repeated in your copy account, scaled to your money. You can add funds, take funds out and stop at any time; stopping sells what the account holds and returns the funds to your main account.

sizing.a: Fixed ratio: each buy spends the same share of your available {asset} as the leader's buy did, from at least {minRatio} {asset}. Fixed amount: each buy costs the amount you set, from at least {minAmount} {asset}. A sell sells the same share of your holding that the leader sold.

failures.q: What happens when a copy fails?
failures.a: A copy fails when your balance is too small, a buy cannot fill within the price cap, or the market will not take the order. It is not retried. After {failures} failed copies in a row the account is closed: what it holds is sold and the funds return to your main account.

lead.q: How do I become a lead trader?
lead.a: Start from "Be a lead trader" with at least {leadMin} {asset}: you get a lead account at once, funded with it. Trade it from the trade screen or with an API key. Every order it fills is copied to your followers. To stop leading, sell what the lead account holds first; each sale is copied to your followers, and their copy accounts are then closed.

share.q: How is the profit share calculated?
share.a: {percent}% of the profit you realize, net of fees, goes to the leader. It is settled weekly, and when you take funds out or stop. A loss is made up before anything more is shared, and nothing is charged on gains you have not realized.

figures.a: Every night each lead account is valued in {asset} at its markets' last trade prices. The return is the change in that value with the leader's own deposits and withdrawals taken out, chained day by day. Max drawdown is the deepest fall from a high in the last 30 days. Funds copying is what the followers' copy accounts hold. The copy success rate is the share of followers' copies that filled.
